name: Everreach Palm
description: Thrust an open palm and keep feeding qi through it so the strike lands farther than the arm should reach.

name: Trailing Thread
description: Loose a line of qi from the fingertip that keeps lengthening as it follows a moving target.

name: Spanning Ward
description: Stretch a ward of qi across the arms and draw it wider as the attack grows broader.

name: Spiral Pace
description: Wind outward from the opponent in a spiral of steps whose arc keeps widening.

name: Stretched Thread
description: Cast a thread of qi to the target's ankle and let it pay out without limit as they pull away.

name: Span Reading
description: Send a thin pulse of qi outward to feel how far away the nearest body stands.

name: Unending Lance
description: Drive a lance of qi forward that keeps extending as long as the user feeds it and breaks guards along its path.

name: Lengthening Lash
description: Crack a lash of qi that grows longer with each swing until it wraps the target at any distance.

name: Piling Fist
description: Strike the same place again and again so each fist rides on the weight of those before.

name: Accrual Step
description: Gain a little speed with each stride so the last step of a run is faster than the first.

name: Accruing Ward
description: Hold a ward that gathers a little qi from every blow it stops and grows firmer in return.

name: Counting Jab
description: Stab a thin jab and add one more point of force for each hit that has already landed.

name: Reservoir Breath
description: Bank each spare breath of qi in the lower body so the next effort draws on a fuller store.

name: Mounting Barrage
description: Throw a barrage of blows in which every strike lands harder than the one before it.

name: Swelling Pressure
description: Lean a field of qi on the opponent that grows heavier each breath until their stance buckles.

name: Inexhaustible Ward
description: Replace the qi a guard loses at the same pace it is spent so the ward never wears thin.

name: Refilling Palm
description: Turn blows aside with an open palm that refills with qi between each deflection.

name: Brimming Guard
description: Keep the guard filled to the brim so a heavy blow spends itself against a full reserve.

name: Persistent Fist
description: Keep a steady fist moving into the opponent's guard and refuse to let the pace slacken.

name: Undiminished Step
description: Hold the length and speed of each step through a long run without any loss.

name: Replenishing Touch
description: Lay a hand on an ally or the self and feed a slow unbroken stream of qi into a wound.

name: Perpetual Aegis
description: Raise an aegis fed by the breath itself so it holds as long as the user keeps standing.

name: Rolling Rebound
description: Return a blow back along the striker's arm and let it keep rolling through them.

name: Boundless Reserve
description: Open a deeper reserve of qi in the dantian that refills a guard and lends strength to the user.

name: Second Echo
description: Land one palm and let the blow ring a second time from the same point.

name: Recurring Wave
description: Loose a wave of qi that curls back toward the target after passing it.

name: Recurrent Jab
description: Repeat a single jab along its own line until the point has bored through the guard.

name: Cycle Step
description: Trace a small circle of steps that returns the body to its start with the opponent turned.

name: Circling Ward
description: Turn a ring of qi around the body that renews itself with each revolution.

name: Cycle Reading
description: Study the repeating pattern of an opponent's attacks to learn which blow comes around next.

name: Reverberating Fist
description: Strike once so that the force reverberates back and forth inside the target and rattles their stance.

name: Revolving Strike
description: Spin through a full turn that carries the first blow into a second and a third without a pause.
